east.subject_description: a young male janitor with brown hair and a red bandana, cream shirt and blue work overalls, holding a red chainsaw stained with blood
east.initial_pose: mid-stride walking pose, legs apart, carrying the chainsaw at waist height with both hands, facing right, seen in profile
east.action_description: He keeps walking forward in place at a steady pace the whole time and never stops: his legs keep striding alternately through one full walk cycle, knees lifting and boots stepping one after the other, exactly like a looping walk cycle. While his legs keep walking, only his upper body attacks: during the first half he slowly heaves the heavy chainsaw up with both hands high above his head, guide bar pointing up and back, leaning back slightly; in the second half he brings it crashing down hard and fast in one vertical overhead chop in front of him until the guide bar points down at the floor. The chain leaves a short bright pale grey streak along the downward arc and a small burst of dust appears where the tip hits the ground. Then he lifts the chainsaw back to his waist, still walking, ending in the same mid-stride walking pose he started in. He keeps facing the same direction the whole time and never lets go of the chainsaw. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.
